source.text_it: A bordo di un autoveicolo o complesso veicolare di massa superiore a sei tonnellate e portata superiore a 3 tonnellate che svolge un trasporto di cose in conto proprio, deve trovarsi la fattura di acquisto delle cose trasportate

records.localized_text: A motor vehicle or combination over six tonnes with payload over 3 tonnes performing own-account goods transport must carry the purchase invoice for the goods transported.

source.text_it: Su ogni veicolo di massa superiore a sei tonnellate e portata superiore a 3,5 tonnellate impegnato in un trasporto intracomunitario o di cabotaggio stradale deve essere presente l’originale della licenza comunitaria

records.localized_text: Every vehicle over six tonnes with payload over 3.5 tonnes engaged in intra-Community transport or road cabotage must carry the original Community licence.

source.text_it: Un conducente italiano impegnato in un trasporto di merci in conto terzi tra Paesi UE o di cabotaggio stradale deve essere munito di attestato del conducente in originale

records.localized_text: An Italian driver carrying goods for third parties between EU countries or performing road cabotage must carry the original driver attestation.

source.text_it: L’autorizzazione CEMT per trasporti merci in conto terzi, non liberalizzati, svolti al di fuori dell’ambito UE o SEE, deve trovarsi in fotocopia a bordo del veicolo durante il trasporto

records.localized_text: A photocopy of the ECMT authorization for non-liberalized third-party goods transport outside the EU or EEA must be carried on the vehicle during transport.

source.text_it: L’autorizzazione CEMT per trasporti merci in conto terzi, non liberalizzati, svolti al di fuori dell’ambito UE o SEE, può essere quinquennale o decennale

records.localized_text: The ECMT authorization for non-liberalized third-party goods transport outside the EU or EEA may be valid for five or ten years.

source.text_it: L’autorizzazione CEMT per trasporti merci in conto terzi, non liberalizzati, svolti al di fuori dell’ambito UE o SEE, deve essere accompagnata da fotocopia autenticata della carta di circolazione del veicolo

records.localized_text: The ECMT authorization for non-liberalized third-party goods transport outside the EU or EEA must be accompanied by a certified copy of the vehicle registration document.

source.text_it: L’autorizzazione per trasporti merci in conto terzi, non liberalizzati, svolti al di fuori dell’ambito UE o SEE, è detta ATP

records.localized_text: Authorization for non-liberalized third-party goods transport outside the EU or EEA is called ATP.

source.text_it: Il conducente di un autobus deve dimostrare, a richiesta degli agenti del traffico, di essere titolare di qualificazione CQC in corso di validità

records.localized_text: A bus driver must, at traffic officers' request, prove that they hold a valid CQC qualification.

source.text_it: Un autocarro, per circolare, deve essere in regola con gli obblighi assicurativi

records.localized_text: A truck must comply with insurance requirements to circulate.

source.text_it: Il conducente di un autobus adibito a noleggio con conducente dotato di tachigrafo digitale deve avere con sé la carta tachigrafica

records.localized_text: The driver of a chauffeur-driven hire bus equipped with a digital tachograph must carry their tachograph card.

source.text_it: La carta tachigrafica contiene il numero di patente del conducente

records.localized_text: The tachograph card contains the driver's licence number.

source.text_it: La carta tachigrafica è rilasciata dalla Camera di commercio

records.localized_text: The tachograph card is issued by the chamber of commerce.

source.text_it: Per circolare con un veicolo a motore in uno Stato non appartenente all’Unione europea occorre il certificato di assicurazione internazionale

records.localized_text: To drive a motor vehicle in a non-EU state, an international insurance certificate is required.

source.text_it: Per guidare un filobus occorre il certificato di idoneità rilasciato dall'USTIF

records.localized_text: Driving a trolleybus requires a certificate of fitness issued by USTIF.

source.text_it: La carta di qualificazione del conducente viene rinnovata ogni cinque anni

records.localized_text: The driver qualification card is renewed every five years.

source.text_it: La qualificazione CQC deve essere rinnovata ogni cinque anni

records.localized_text: The CQC qualification must be renewed every five years.

source.text_it: Una copia conforme dell'autorizzazione al noleggio con conducente deve essere presente a bordo dell'autobus immatricolato in base ad essa

records.localized_text: A certified copy of the chauffeur-driven hire authorization must be carried on the bus registered under it.

source.text_it: Per rinnovare la qualificazione CQC occorre seguire un corso di formazione periodica

records.localized_text: Renewing the CQC qualification requires attending a periodic training course.

source.text_it: Per guidare un autobus occorre essere titolare di certificato di abilitazione professionale di tipo KD

records.localized_text: Driving a bus requires a KD professional qualification certificate.

source.text_it: Per rinnovare la qualificazione CQC occorre sottoporsi a visita medica

records.localized_text: Renewing the CQC qualification requires a medical examination.

source.text_it: La carta tachigrafica è rilasciata dall'Ufficio Motorizzazione civile competente del territorio di residenza del richiedente

records.localized_text: The tachograph card is issued by the Civil Motorization Office responsible for the applicant's place of residence.

source.text_it: Per guidare un filobus occorre il certificato di idoneità rilasciato dalla Prefettura competente per territorio

records.localized_text: Driving a trolleybus requires a certificate of fitness issued by the locally competent Prefecture.

source.text_it: Per guidare un filobus occorre un certificato professionale ATP rilasciato dall'Ufficio Motorizzazione civile competente per territorio

records.localized_text: Driving a trolleybus requires an ATP professional certificate issued by the locally competent Civil Motorization Office.

source.text_it: Per effettuare un servizio di autotrasporto verso un altro Stato dell’Unione europea è necessario avere il passaporto

records.localized_text: A passport is required to perform road transport services to another EU state.

source.text_it: La carta tachigrafica del conducente non ha scadenza

records.localized_text: The driver tachograph card has no expiry date.

rows.text: Own-account transport can include goods in the undertaking’s possession, not just goods it purchased. For the transport described, a list of the goods is required, not necessarily their purchase invoice.
evidence: Provincia di Modena, trasporto conto proprio e riferimenti L. 298/1974 e DPR 783/1977: https://www.provincia.modena.it/servizio/trasporto-merci-in-conto-proprio/

Confartigianato Ravenna, guida conto proprio, documento di trasporto ed elenco per massa oltre 6 t e portata oltre 3 t: https://assets.confartigianato.ra.it/archivio/documenti/2478/Guida_gestione_automezzi_conto_proprio-2021_06_11_15_08.pdf

rows.text: The original Community licence stays with the haulier. A certified true copy must be kept in the vehicle and presented for inspection.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 1072/2009, artt. 4(3),(6), 5(1) e 8: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/IT/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32009R1072

rows.text: Subject to the stated conditions, the driver attestation concerns drivers who are neither nationals of a Member State nor long-term residents. An Italian driver is an EU national and does not need it for that reason.
evidence: Regolamento (CE) 1072/2009, artt. 4(3),(6), 5(1) e 8: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/IT/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32009R1072

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: under the paper system a simple photocopy did not replace the original licence. Since 2026 the licence is digital and must be valid; its system-generated information document is available on board digitally or printed for inspection.
evidence: ITF ECMT Multilateral Quota User Guide January 2026, introduction and sections 4.9, 5.1–5.6, 6.1–6.2: digital system replaces printed licences and logbooks from 1 January 2026; a valid licence and updated electronic journey records remain required; system-generated licence and journey information documents must be available in digital or printed form for inspection. Technical vehicle certificates have separate requirements. https://www.mindop.sk/fileadmin/documents/doprava/cesta/scd/CEMT_info_v%C5%A1eobecn%C3%A9/user_guide_2026_CEMT.pdf

Supplied official superiori quiz: preserves printed verdict and paper-era original/fotocopia/libretto wording; current electronic information documents are not treated as unauthorised photocopies of the historic paper licence.

rows.text: ECMT licences are annual or short-term, not valid for five or ten years. The current guide sets a 30-day validity for short-term licences.
evidence: ITF, ECMT Multilateral Quota User Guide 2026, §§ 3.5–3.6, 4 e 5: https://www.itf-oecd.org/sites/default/files/docs/user_guide_2026_e.pdf

rows.text: A certified copy of the registration document is not the document accompanying the ECMT licence. The system instead provides for licence and journey documentation and the relevant vehicle technical certificates.
evidence: ITF, ECMT Multilateral Quota User Guide 2026, §§ 3.5–3.6, 4 e 5: https://www.itf-oecd.org/sites/default/files/docs/user_guide_2026_e.pdf; §§ 4–5 e allegati 4–6, documenti di viaggio e certificati tecnici

MIT, listato ufficiale quesiti 28189–28190: certificati tecnici e resoconti di viaggio, contesto della domanda: https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1?version=1.0

rows.text: ECMT refers to the multilateral licensing system for certain international goods transport. ATP concerns international carriage of perishable foodstuffs and the associated equipment.
evidence: ITF, ECMT Multilateral Quota User Guide 2026, §§ 3.5–3.6, 4 e 5: https://www.itf-oecd.org/sites/default/files/docs/user_guide_2026_e.pdf
UNECE, accordo ATP, oggetto: https://unece.org/transport/road-transport/text-and-status-agreement

rows.text: For professional bus driving subject to the requirement, a valid passenger CQC qualification is needed in addition to the licence. The driver must be able to prove the qualification during a check.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008
D.Lgs. 286/2005, artt. 14 e 18, campo e documentazione della qualificazione: https://mit.gov.it/normativa/decreto-legislativo-numero-286-del-21112005

rows.text: A truck must have compulsory third-party liability insurance to circulate on roads. It covers damage caused to third parties by its circulation.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 193, come modificato dal D.Lgs. 184/2023: https://www.gazzettaufficiale.it/atto/serie_generale/caricaArticoloDefault/originario?atto.codiceRedazionale=23G00196&atto.dataPubblicazioneGazzetta=2023-12-13&atto.tipoProvvedimento=DECRETO+LEGISLATIVO

rows.text: The driver’s personal card is used in the digital tachograph while driving to record activities. It must therefore be available for use and inspection.
evidence: Regolamento (UE) 165/2014, artt. 34 e 36, uso ed esibizione della carta: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/IT/TXT/?uri=CELEX%3A32014R0165

rows.text: The driver card identifies its holder and also records the driving licence number at the time of issue. It is not itself a driving licence.
evidence: Regolamento di esecuzione (UE) 2016/799, allegato IC, dati della carta conducente: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2016/799/2016-05-26/eng
Camera di commercio Treviso-Belluno, carte tachigrafiche, rilascio e durata: https://www.tb.camcom.gov.it/content/12680/Bisogni/Carta_tachigrafica.html

rows.text: In Italy, the competent chambers of commerce issue tachograph cards and also handle their renewal and replacement.
evidence: Camera di commercio Treviso-Belluno, carte tachigrafiche, rilascio e durata: https://www.tb.camcom.gov.it/content/12680/Bisogni/Carta_tachigrafica.html

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE, but whether a green card is needed depends on the country: for example, it is not required in Switzerland for an Italian-registered vehicle. Check the coverage and documents required for the destination.
evidence: UCI, Carta verde, elenco paesi: Svizzera senza carta verde per veicoli italiani; altri paesi la richiedono: https://ucimi.it/carta-verde/
MIT, listato ufficiale, quesito 28207, verdetto VERO: https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI.pdf/28087c34-6916-44bd-a6b9-9bd3b7e863b7?version=1.0

rows.text: Driving a trolleybus requires a specific certificate of fitness, distinct from the driving licence for the corresponding category. In the quiz’s terminology, USTIF issues the certificate.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 118 e regolamento; MIT, relazione filobus § 4.3.1, certificato e patente: https://digifema.mit.gov.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Relazione_Finale_Filobus_31-10-2022_pubblica.pdf; MIT, listato 2021 quesito 7408, identifica USTIF: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-09/Flusso%20Poligrafico.pdf

rows.text: The CQC qualification is valid for five years and is renewed through periodic training. The driving licence has its own renewal rules.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008

rows.text: The CQC qualification is renewed every five years after the required periodic training; renewal keeps the professional qualification valid.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008

rows.text: The certified copy connects the bus to the undertaking’s authorisation. The law requires it to be kept aboard each bus registered under that authorisation.
evidence: Legge 218/2003, art. 5 comma 5: https://www.parlamento.it/parlam/leggi/03218l.htm

rows.text: Renewing the CQC requires attendance at the prescribed periodic training. It updates the driver’s professional qualification.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008

rows.text: Under current rules, the KD professional certificate is not the qualification required for professional bus driving. The appropriate driving licence and, where required, the passenger CQC are needed.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008
MIT, circolare 69656/2008, passaggio dal KD alla CQC: https://www.mit.gov.it/normativa/circolare-protocollo-69656-del-03092008-0

rows.text: The CQC is renewed through periodic training; a medical examination instead concerns renewal of the driving licence under its own rules. The two procedures and expiry dates are separate.
evidence: MIT, Carta qualificazione del conducente, requisiti e rinnovo: https://www.mit.gov.it/node/3008
MIT, circolare 14587/2013, rinnovo contestuale patente e CQC: https://www.mit.gov.it/index.php/normativa/circolare-protocollo-14587-del-06062013

rows.text: In Italy, the competent chamber of commerce issues the tachograph card, not the Civil Motorization Office.
evidence: Camera di commercio Treviso-Belluno, carte tachigrafiche, rilascio e durata: https://www.tb.camcom.gov.it/content/12680/Bisogni/Carta_tachigrafica.html

rows.text: The trolleybus driving fitness certificate is not issued by the Prefecture. The quiz identifies USTIF as the competent office.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 118 e regolamento; MIT, relazione filobus § 4.3.1, certificato e patente: https://digifema.mit.gov.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Relazione_Finale_Filobus_31-10-2022_pubblica.pdf; MIT, listato 2021 quesito 7408, identifica USTIF: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-09/Flusso%20Poligrafico.pdf

rows.text: ATP concerns equipment for transporting perishable foodstuffs, not a professional certificate for driving trolleybuses. A specific driving fitness qualification is required for a trolleybus.
evidence: Codice della strada art. 118 e regolamento; MIT, relazione filobus § 4.3.1, certificato e patente: https://digifema.mit.gov.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Relazione_Finale_Filobus_31-10-2022_pubblica.pdf; MIT, listato 2021 quesito 7408, identifica USTIF: https://www.mit.gov.it/nfsmitgov/files/media/normativa/2021-09/Flusso%20Poligrafico.pdf
UNECE, accordo ATP e attrezzature: https://unece.org/transport/road-transport/text-and-status-agreement

rows.text: A passport is not always necessary: an EU citizen can travel to other Member States with a valid national identity card for travel. Rules for non-EU nationals may differ.
evidence: Commissione europea, documenti di viaggio per cittadini UE: https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/travel/entry-exit/eu-citizen/index_en.htm

rows.text: The driver tachograph card expires: in Italy it is valid for five years and must be renewed.
evidence: Camera di commercio Treviso-Belluno, carte tachigrafiche, rilascio e durata: https://www.tb.camcom.gov.it/content/12680/Bisogni/Carta_tachigrafica.html

review_evidence: The ITF guide cited directly for 28188–28189 or 28198–28200 returned HTTP 403; independently inspected the ITF 2026 guide via https://www.mindop.sk/fileadmin/documents/doprava/cesta/scd/CEMT_info_v%C5%A1eobecn%C3%A9/user_guide_2026_CEMT.pdf, especially sections 3.5–3.6, 4.9–4.11 and 5–6. The ITF landing page identifies the _e.pdf as the official guide. The MIT CQC page was verified through its indexed exact URL when direct access returned 502.

issues.reason: Il verdetto FALSO presuppone la licenza cartacea originale, ma la guida CEMT 2026 introduce la licenza digitale e consente il documento informativo stampato a bordo. Non è chiaro se una fotocopia cartacea della licenza del quiz corrisponda al documento informativo stampato ammesso nel sistema vigente; serve adjudicazione del rapporto tra formulazione e sistema digitale.
checked_sources: ITF, ECMT Multilateral Quota User Guide 2026, §§ 3.4–3.6 e 4: https://www.itf-oecd.org/sites/default/files/docs/user_guide_2026_e.pdf — licenza gestita digitalmente e documento informativo digitale o stampato.

MIT, listato ufficiale quesiti 28187 e 28197: https://www.ilportaledellautomobilista.it/documents/56611/85457073/DOMANDE%2BSUPERIORI23-10.pdf/8673967c-c17e-421d-8f67-b711a33194c1?version=1.0 — originale VERO, fotocopia FALSO.
